knownCommands.description: Command names (wildcards * and ? allowed) that the undefined-command check treats as defined, e.g. commands provided by a host tool.

hosts.description: Per-file tables for host tools (Vivado, Quartus ...): each host applies to the files its match patterns select.

match.description: Glob patterns on the workspace-relative path: ** any depth, * within a folder, ? one character. A pattern without / matches in any folder.

knownCommands.description: Command names (wildcards allowed) accepted for the matching files.

commands.description: Extra commands for the matching files (same format as the top-level commands).

check.description: Run the undefined-command check on the matching files (needs a plain tclsh for introspection). Default false.

commands.description: Extra commands, keyed by name. They appear in completion, hover and signature help and are never reported as undefined.

sig.description: Argument signature shown after the command name.

doc.description: Description used for both languages when en/zh are not given.
